_comment: Core plumbing nodes a value passes through. `value_through` lists the inputs recognition follows when another node's exposed input is wired from one of these, so the control lands on the literal(s) behind it: an If/Else Switch carries either branch (both are followed — a subgraph's prompt is exported as the same literal on each side, and both must be written), a Preview as Text carries its source. `reports_text` marks the preview as a node whose output is the text that went through it; when the prompt runs through one, GENie reads the final prompt back from the finished run (see docs/COMFYUI.md, Prompt enhancers). A switch's own `switch` is exposed only where its role is recognizable: gating a Generate Text (a prompt enhancer), or choosing the sampler's latent (a custom size vs. the size the encoder derived from the first image).

switch.name: prompt_enhancer
switch.label: Rewrite the prompt with the LLM before encoding

switch.name: custom_size
switch.label: Custom size (off: use the first image's size)
